name: R027-thrash-ghost-cancels-lock
why: Challenge 3. The player's Tauros (set 408, Thrash in slot 1) uses Thrash on turn 1 and knocks out the opponent's lead Dugtrio (set 372: about 130-154 damage against 101 HP). Thrash's lock (2 or 3 turns) goes on, and both of the opponent's other Pokemon are Ghosts (Misdreavus 374, Dusclops 378), so the replacement is a Ghost. On turn 2 the locked Thrash does not affect it (targetNotAffected), and at the end of that turn the Thrash tick sees WasUnableToUseMove and cancels the lock. Tauros is faster than both Ghosts; a Confuse Ray or Thunder Wave from them first only adds the self-hit / full-paralysis ways to the same branch. Risks: Dugtrio's critical Earthquake, or a Tri Attack burn/freeze before the Thrash.

onHold.result: no matching hit in 2 seeds (hunt stopped)
